name: astro
title: Astronomy
summary: Orbital dynamics, galactic dynamics, cosmology codes, sky maps and MCMC fitting, on top of the Astropy that the base pack has. No catalogues or survey data are included.

tools.name: rebound
tools.does: N-body integrator for planetary and stellar dynamics, with symplectic and high-accuracy integrators
tools.check: python -c "import rebound; s=rebound.Simulation(); s.add(m=1); s.add(m=1e-3,a=1); s.integrate(6.283185307); print('x', round(s.particles[1].x,2))"

tools.name: galpy
tools.does: galactic dynamics: potentials, orbits, rotation curves, action-angle coordinates
tools.usage: python: from galpy.potential import MWPotential2014; from galpy.orbit import Orbit
tools.check: python -c "from galpy.potential import MWPotential2014, vcirc; print('vc', round(float(vcirc(MWPotential2014,1.)),2))"

tools.name: camb
tools.does: cosmology: CMB power spectra, matter power spectra and background quantities for a given set of parameters
tools.check: python -c "import camb; p=camb.CAMBparams(); p.set_cosmology(H0=67.5, ombh2=0.022, omch2=0.122); print('age', round(camb.get_background(p).physical_time(0),1))"

tools.name: healpy
tools.does: maps on the sphere in the HEALPix scheme: pixelisation, spherical harmonics, smoothing
tools.check: python -c "import healpy as hp; print('npix', hp.nside2npix(64))"

tools.name: emcee and corner
tools.does: MCMC sampling of a posterior (emcee) and corner plots of the samples
tools.check: python -c "import emcee, corner, numpy as np; s=emcee.EnsembleSampler(8,1,lambda x: -0.5*float(x[0])**2); s.run_mcmc(np.random.default_rng(1).normal(size=(8,1)),50); print('chain', s.get_chain().shape)"

tools.name: photutils
tools.does: source detection and photometry on astronomical images
